annotations.title: Place the same call to a list of numbers in France

description:
Place the same call to a list of numbers in France (Pro and Enterprise plans) and get back a batch_id with one call_id per number. Compliance: the AI disclosure is always made; marketing, prospecting, surveys and mass calling of people who did not expect it are unlawful and refused; anti-harassment limits per number apply.

    Use it when the user explicitly asks to make the same kind of call to several numbers they provide (e.g. confirm tomorrow's appointments with their own customers, ask several garages for a quote). The account's limits apply: calls run a few at a time (simultaneous-call limit; the rest wait their turn), the batch is refused if it exceeds the calls left for the last 24 hours, automatic retries and calls still waiting 15 minutes after the requested time stay within 08:00-21:00 callee's time. Each call is paid like a single call. Returns immediately; follow it with get_batch_calls, or each call with get_call. Starter accounts get plan_feature_required: tell the user.

language.description: Language of the calls; omit for the account default.
language.title: Language

name.description: Optional batch name, e.g. 'Tuesday appointment confirmations'.
name.title: Name

phone_numbers.description: Numbers to call, French only, copied as given ('01 42 00 00 00' or +33…); 100 at most. Duplicates and invalid numbers are skipped and listed in refused. Every number must come from the user.
phone_numbers.title: Phone Numbers

scheduled_at.description: When to start (ISO 8601 with time zone). Omit to start now.
scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At

task.description: The same task for every call, as in place_phone_call (goal, on whose behalf, facts, limits). Never marketing or prospecting.
task.title: Task

voice.description: Optional voice; omit for the account default.
voice.title: Voice
